name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
description: With one arm straight out in front and the palm up, use the other hand to ease the fingers and hand back toward the floor, stretching the inside of the forearm.

source.title: Hinge Health: How to do a wrist flexor stretch
source.note: Described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation. The figure has no wrists: it shows the arm and the other hand at the fingers; the cue says how to bend the hand back.

setup: Hold one arm straight out in front of you at shoulder height, palm up.
cues: Feel it along the inside of the forearm.

prescription.note: Keep the elbow straight and pull gently: you should feel it along the inside of the forearm, not in the wrist joint.

keyframes.name: Arm out, palm up
keyframes.cue: Right arm straight out in front, palm up.

keyframes.name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
keyframes.cue: With your left hand, ease your right fingers down and back.

keyframes.name: Release
keyframes.cue: Let go and lower your arm.
